title: Monotonicity of cumulative miss probability
statement: Let $G$ be a finite regular multigraph of positive degree, and let $s,t$ be vertices. For every natural number $N$, the cumulative miss probability for hitting $t$ from $s$ through step $N-1$ is at most the corresponding cumulative miss probability through step $N$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph of positive degree
